title: The Question Comes First

criteria.name: Hook & retention
criteria.notes: The large 19, fixed-contact macro and open notebook are immediately readable at 0 to 2 seconds; NEXT STEP supplies a concrete question, paid by the additional page at 93.14 seconds. The person planted at 52.8 seconds returns to the test at 107.8 seconds. The 13.7 to 28.7 second funding/training section is informative but less surprising than either payoff, slightly tempering retention.

criteria.name: Illustration craft & detail
criteria.notes: The headset at 33.9 seconds has rim, rib, pad and socket tiers with coherent shading; the recurring notebook has layered page edges, stitching, dog-ears and convincing contact shadow. Hands retain shaded sleeves and outlined finger shapes. The programming monitor at 62.9 seconds and training/test panels at 112.6 seconds are visibly plainer than the notebook and instrument in the same film, with broad nearly uniform fills and fewer material cues. This is an execution comparison inside the flat-vector style.

criteria.name: Motion & animation craft
criteria.notes: All forty sequential strips and seven supplemental action grids were inspected. The 16.03 to 17.10 second lab-name placement shows approach, overshoot and settling; the 32.23 to 34.37 second contact emphasis keeps the electrode fixed; the 88.1 to 90.77 second inventory comparison moves the question among visible records. The extra page visibly expands at 93.13 to 93.93 seconds and the same person enters only TEST at 107.8 to 108.6 seconds. Motion is real beyond camera drift. Repeated short sideways arm-and-tab placements at 59.7 to 60.4 and 99.6 to 100.3 seconds have modest wrist articulation and receiver reaction, so the performance range remains narrower than the best prop staging.

criteria.name: Composition & staging
criteria.notes: Clear cream-on-violet hierarchy, safe caption separation and distinct training/test areas make the argument easy to follow. The source and qualifier labels remain separate from the main actions. Across 42.9 to 78.5 seconds and 93.1 to 123.3 seconds, many shots reuse the same frontal window, platform and centered page stack at similar scale; the broad lower-floor area contributes less than the active central composition. This reduces visual variety without creating a readability blocker. Scored the 9:16 master only; the contact sheet is full-height despite its filename.

criteria.name: Color & grade
criteria.notes: Lilac daylight, ivory paper, citron task markers and coral tabs make a coherent, specific research-workspace world. Violet form shading, warm window light and subtle surface variation keep the paper and equipment distinct. The palette is visibly different from the September 11th cream/spruce/plum reference, and the storyboard records a separate September 10th dark-glacier look. No unexplained blue default or visible banding found.

criteria.name: Typography & captions
criteria.notes: The full-size stills show crisp dark labels and large high-contrast open captions, with aligned cue changes visible in the motion strips. Planned status and schematic labels remain readable, including the separate eye-movement and brain-activity labels at 62.9 seconds. Some small support text, such as the study-target strip around 61.3 seconds, is less immediate at phone scale than the principal captions, and much of the type enters as complete labels rather than expressive kinetic phrasing. No typo, incorrect number or unreadable main caption found.

criteria.name: Sound design & mix
criteria.notes: Measured evidence passes: master integrated loudness -14.67 LUFS, true peak -3.04 dBTP and LRA 6.9 LU; AAC verification also passes. The event manifest has forty motivated events across all shots, and the objective report verifies twenty-three audible lifts and a 50.1 dB bed dip at 118.19 seconds. The current ending visibly credits Life of Riley, Kevin MacLeod and CC BY 4.0. These support a competent layered mix. I did not listen to the soundtrack, so timbral blend, performance warmth and subjective musical fit are not independently auditioned; no audible defect is invented from that limitation.

criteria.name: VO–illustration sync & entertainment
criteria.notes: The captioned clock and sequential frames align the scalp-contact explanation at 32.2 seconds, cognitive-state label at 59.7 seconds, paired observations at 65.3 seconds, extra page at 93.14 seconds and held-out person at 107.78 seconds with their spoken concepts. The notebook remains an intelligible throughline. The funding/training section and repeated page-label presentations around 69 to 78 seconds are more explanatory than entertaining, but the later spatial payoffs earn the premise.

criteria.name: Accuracy & sourcing
criteria.notes: The current claims, fact-check boundaries, script and post agree with the independently opened UAA announcement: acquisition, training, funding, Egorov's public-data use and the two planned studies. Nineteen scalp contacts are countable in the 33.9-second still and corroborated by the manufacturer specification. Schematic traces and blank interpretation fields avoid a fabricated result. The Frontiers methods paper supports holding entire people out for new-person generalization, and the 106.1 to 118.9 second sequence explicitly separates this general example from UAA plans. The acquisition and study details ultimately depend on one institutional announcement, so this falls short of the rubric's two-primary-source ideal for every load-bearing fact.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & cultural respect
criteria.notes: The story centers UAA, its named lab, its funding source and a named graduate student as agents in Alaska research. It credits local capability without inventing community consensus or casting outside technology as a rescue. The illustration avoids borrowed Native motifs and medical-success imagery. The workspace could belong to many universities, so Alaska specificity comes mainly from reporting and labels rather than distinctive place staging.

criteria.name: Writing & post quality
criteria.notes: The VO opens with a concrete number and an unanswered page, explains why a collection option matters, preserves useful public data and closes with an answerable research question. The post's opening names the earned win and its later caveat is explicitly a general principle. Both remain plainspoken and respect plans versus findings. The compressed display wording IF A MODEL CLAIMS NEW PEOPLE at 106 to 113 seconds is less natural than the complete spoken phrase, though the surrounding labels make its meaning clear.

one_sentence_fix: Add a clearer wrist rotation and a small page or holder reaction to the tab placements around 59.7 and 99.6 seconds to vary the repeated sideways reaches.
calibration_scope: Inspected all five prescribed September 11th historical reference images and all three unchanged historical judge cards. Their axis medians describe the historical whole film, not separately rated stills and not an owner-approved aesthetic target. Used them to orient the within-style scale only; current scores come from the current evidence. No other current judge card was inspected.
evidence_limits: Visual assessment used all forty actual sequential filmstrips, seven current action grids, four whole-film taste sheets, the current contact sheet and six full-resolution stills, including credits. Master SHA256 was computed independently and matched both current receipts. This was not a continuous audiovisual playback or a listening session; audio craft is assessed from current measurements and event/voice reports. Square delivery was not separately artistically scored.
rationale: A coherent, legible and factually disciplined research explainer with two earned spatial payoffs. The repeated frontal page staging and limited variety of hand performances hold the craft score below the strongest within-style work, but no hard blocker was found.
